subject: Shared: Joint Pilot Playbook + 30-day Evaluation Schematic
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Joint Pilot Playbook + 30-day Evaluation Schematic

Emma —

Thanks again for a great conversation today. Per our discussion I put together a compact pilot playbook and a 30-day evaluation schematic that focuses on three tight gates (integration, throughput, and quality). The goal here is to give your team a lean artifact you can share internally that maps responsibilities, acceptance criteria, and expected outcomes week-by-week.

What’s in the seed doc (attached + link below):
- One-page executive summary (goal, success metrics)
- Week-by-week milestones W0 -> W4 with explicit owners
- Acceptance gates: A (infra access), B (golden prompts + perf baseline), C (production smoke)
- Deliverable templates: infra checklist, test prompt suite, latency heatmap stub
- Quick playbook for rollback & fallback model variants

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b3C-redwood-MAP-seed
Attachments: redwood-MAP-compact-template.gdoc, 30d-eval-schematic.pdf

Proposed next steps:
1) You (Brightpath) confirm infra account access and sample dataset by Mon 9/20
2) We run an integration spike (W0) and produce a perf baseline (W1)
3) Joint review at end of W2 to decide canary cadence and acceptance thresholds

Ben — flagged you for the ops checklist and Neha I included you for the eval metric set and any compliance callouts (data handling, logs).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick sync to walk this doc if that helps.

—
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Emma Li <emma@brightpath.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Brightpath Procurement <procure@brightpath.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Joint Pilot Playbook + 30-day Evaluation Schematic

Jasmine —

Appreciate the rapid turnaround and the concise format. This is exactly the level of detail our execs want to see. Quick clarification/questions from our side before we circulate internally:

• For the infra access gate (A), can you list the minimal IAM roles and a short example of the sample payload we should hand you? (we prefer checklist items)
• On quality acceptance (gate B), can you add a short example of an automated pass/fail criterion (e.g., top-1 accuracy on labeled set + manual review %)?
• Who on Redwood will own rollbacks and canary aborts during the trial?

Procurement looped in for timeline awareness — we should be able to confirm account provisioning by 9/20 but need to validate an IP/data NDA first.

If you can add the two small examples into the doc I’ll push it to our stakeholders and propose an internal decision meeting for 9/22.

Thanks,
Emma Li
Head of AI | Brightpath.ai
emma@brightpath.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@brightpath.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Joint Pilot Playbook + 30-day Evaluation Schematic

Emma —

Thanks — I’ll add the infra checklist and a minimal IAM snippet to the doc by EOD. High level: we need a service account with permissions to upload sample payloads to the staging bucket and to request inference tokens for the trial cluster. Action items I’ll drop into the W0 checklist:
- Create service account: roles/storage.objectAdmin (staging bucket), roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor (for test creds)
- Provide sample payload: 200 anonymized records (JSONL) and schema sample (fields + max token lengths)
- Network: allow outbound to redwood-serving.redwood.ai on 443; if you restrict egress we’ll need VPN details

Also — for the rollback owner: Redwood SRE will own canary aborts and automated rollback; I’ll be the on-call lead during W1/W2. We’ll add a point-person cell in the doc (Ben Carter) and an escalation path to SRE.

Neha — can you review the proposed eval pass/fail schema (Emma’s ask) and propose a concise automated criterion we can run at W2 review?

—Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Li <emma@brightpath.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Joint Pilot Playbook + 30-day Evaluation Schematic

On Tue, Sep 14, 2026 at 12:30 PM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Emma —
> 
> Thanks — I’ll add the infra checklist and a minimal IAM snippet to the doc by EOD.

Thanks all — I reviewed the seed and drafted a concise pass/fail rule for gate B. I added the following to the doc (see attachment + inline):

Proposed automated criterion (Gate B):
- Run the provided 500-sample labeled set through candidate model; pass if:
  • Top-1 accuracy >= 78% on labeled classification tasks OR
  • For generation tasks: average BLEU >= 0.45 and < 8% hallucination rate on manual spot-check sample (50 items)
- If automated criteria fail, allow one remediation run after prompt and temp param tuning; second failure triggers rollback decision meeting.

I also included a short privacy note about log retention during trial: logs stored for 30 days in customer-owned bucket; access granted to Redwood SRE for debugging under a JIT token. Please confirm if Brightpath legal is comfortable with that.

Next steps I recorded in doc:
- Brightpath to confirm IAM/ppayload by 2026-09-20
- Redwood to finalize infra checklist + IAM snippet by 2026-09-15 (Ben)
- Joint decision meeting: 2026-09-22 (stakeholder alignment)

Emma — happy to hop on the 9/22 decision meeting; I’ll also prepare a 2-slide summary of acceptance metrics for the execs.

—
Neha Kapoor
Senior Product Manager, Eval & Reliability | Redwood Inference
